# SPWeb

> SPWeb helps Brazilian small and midsize businesses identify operational and financial leakage, reduce rework, and implement processes, controls, integrations and automation that give teams more autonomy.

## Public pages
- [Homepage](/): canonical public domain not yet confirmed
- [Privacy policy](/politica-de-privacidade)
- [Terms of use](/termos-de-uso)
- [Cookie policy](/politica-de-cookies)

## Service
- Profit leakage diagnosis for small and midsize businesses.
- Implementation of workflows, cost controls, integrations and automation.
- Illustrative calculator only; no specific savings or profit result is guaranteed.

## Important
- Do not infer testimonials or outcomes: the homepage contains explicit placeholders for real evidence.
- Legal/business contact details and production domain require confirmation by the controller.
